assistant|madewell_brand_info: Madewell: trendy, fashion-forward American brand known for denim; similar pricing to J.Crew Factory; more relaxed fit and fashion-forward fabrics; products include High-Rise Skinny Jeans ($70), Silk Cami Top ($40), Faux Leather Jacket ($120)
